summary: Defines how the Internet Architecture Board (IAB) produces, reviews, and publishes its own documents as RFCs. The IAB occasionally issues statements and architectural guidance, and this memo sets out the process those documents follow on their way into the RFC Series.

eli5.summary: A group of advisers sometimes writes official notes for everyone to read. This note is the checklist that says how those notes get written, checked by others, and finally printed.

questions: how does the iab publish rfcs
